8400.grammar: inf of na bhuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)
8400.meaning1: to not eat; to not consume
8400.construction:
na > a + bhuñja + ituṃ
a + bhuñjituṃ

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū asakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjanti abhuñjitu'kāmā viya

8401.grammar: abs of na bhuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)
8401.construction:
na > a + bhuñja + itvā
na + bhuñjitvā

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ abhuñjitvā iminā'va jighacchādubbalyena evaṃ imaṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyyan'ti.

8402.grammar: aor 1st sg of abhuñji, irreg form of abhuñjiṃ, trans (+acc)

examples.text: kuḍḍamūlañ'ca nissāya, ālopaṃ taṃ abhuñjisaṃ, bhuñjamāne vā bhutte vā, jegucchaṃ me na vijjati.

8403.commentary: (THa) bahuṃ yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsū'ti paṇītaṃ bahuṃ bhuñjantā'pi yāpanamattam'eva āhāraṃ bhuñjiṃsu.

examples.text: paṇītaṃ yadi vā lūkhaṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ, yāpan'atthaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, agiddhā n'ādhimucchitā.
sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ. matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itar'ītare.

8404.grammar: fem, abstr, from na bhutta, neg
8404.construction:
na > a + √bhuj + ta + tā
abhutta + tā

8405.meaning1: (vinaya) done by one who has not eaten
8405.commentary: (VINa) abhuttāvinā katan'ti yo alam'etaṃ sabban'ti atirittaṃ karoti, tena pavāraṇappahonakaṃ bhojanaṃ abhuttena kataṃ.

examples.text: anatirittaṃ nāma akappiyakataṃ hoti, appaṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, anuccāritakataṃ hoti, ahatthapāse kataṃ hoti, abhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti

8406.grammar: adj, app of na bhuñjati, neg
8406.commentary: (VINa) abhuttāvinā katan'ti yo alam'etaṃ sabban'ti atirittaṃ karoti, tena pavāraṇappahonakaṃ bhojanaṃ abhuttena kataṃ.

examples.text: anatirittaṃ nāma akappiyakataṃ hoti, appaṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, anuccāritakataṃ hoti, ahatthapāse kataṃ hoti, abhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā vuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti
purebhattaṃ nāma yena nimantito taṃ abhuttāvī. pacchābhattaṃ nāma yena nimantito taṃ antamaso kus'aggena'pi bhuttaṃ hoti.

8407.grammar: abs of na bhuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: cattāro pañca ālope, abhutvā udakaṃ pive, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

8408.grammar: abs of na bhuñjati, neg, trans (+acc)
8408.meaning1: (of sensual pleasures) having not enjoyed; having not partaken of

examples.text: abhutvā bhikkhasi bhikkhu, na hi bhutvāna bhikkhasi, bhutvāna bhikkhu bhikkhassu, mā taṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.
kālaṃ vo'haṃ na jānāmi, channo kālo na dissati, tasmā abhutvā bhikkhāmi, mā maṃ kālo upaccagā'ti.

8409.commentary: (MNa) abhum'me'ti bhū'ti vaḍḍhi, abhū'ti avaḍḍhi, vināso mayhan'ti attho. (JAa) abhum'me'ti abhūtaṃ vata me katheyyāsi.

examples.text: abhum'me kathaṃ nu bhaṇasi, sallaṃ me deva urasi kappesi, sattasatā te bhariyā, kathaṃ nu te tā bhavissanti.

8410.meaning1: oh horror!; terrible!; awful!; monstrous!; aaargh!
8410.meaning2: exclamation of horror; exclamation of fright; exclamation of aversion

examples.text: so chavasīsassa pattaṃ dhāreti. aññatarā itthī passitvā bhītā vissaram'akāsi, abhuṃ me pisāco vat'āyan'ti.

8411.commentary: (UDa) kāraṇena vinā, sayam'eva vā na bhūtaṃ na pātubhūtaṃ na uppannan'ti abhūtaṃ

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, ajātaṃ abhūtaṃ akataṃ asaṅkhataṃ

8412.commentary: (MNa) abhūtavādī'ti yaṃ n'atthi, tassa vattā. (ANa) abhūtavādī'ti bhūtaṃ na vadati, abhūtaṃ vadati nāma.

examples.text: samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ
tatra, bhikkhave, yaṃ jaññā rahovādaṃ abhūtaṃ atacchaṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ sasakkaṃ, taṃ rahovādaṃ na bhāseyya.

8413.grammar: nt, pp of na bhavati, neg

examples.text: ye te, bho gotama, evam'āhaṃsu, samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkh'ājīviṃ ek'aṃsena upakkosati upavadatī'ti, kacci te bhoto gotamassa vuttavādino, na ca bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, dhammassa c'ānudhammaṃ byākaronti, na ca koci sahadhammiko vād'ānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati?

8415.commentary: (ANa) abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hotī'ti abhūtena abbhakkhānaṃ saṃvatteti, yena kenaci kataṃ tass'eva upari patati.

examples.text: musāvādo, bhikkhave, āsevito bhāvito bahulīkato nirayasaṃvattaniko tiracchānayonisaṃvattaniko pettivisayasaṃvattaniko. yo sabbalahuso musāvādassa vipāko, manussabhūtassa abhūt'abbhakkhāna-saṃvattaniko hoti.

cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā vikālavisikhācariy'ānuyoge. attā'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, puttadāro'pi'ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, sāpateyyaṃ'pi'ssa aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ hoti, saṅkiyo ca hoti pāpakesu ṭhānesu, abhūtavacanañ'ca tasmiṃ rūhati, bahūnañ'ca dukkhadhammānaṃ purakkhato hoti.

8418.commentary: (MNa) abhūtavādī'ti yaṃ n'atthi, tassa vattā. (ANa) abhūtavādī'ti bhūtaṃ na vadati, abhūtaṃ vadati nāma. (ANa) asabhāvaṃ vadatī'ti abhūtavādī.

examples.text: abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.
samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ

8419.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of na bhūta, neg
8419.construction:
na > a + √bhū + ta + ena
abhūta + ena

examples.text: idha no, āvuso sāriputta, bhagavā kiṃvādī kim'akkhāyī, kathaṃ byākaramānā ca mayaṃ vuttavādino c'eva bhagavato assāma, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma
taggha taṃ, bhikkhu, accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo tvaṃ sāriputtaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhi

8420.meaning1: indivisible; not able to be split apart; inseparable

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? abhejjapariso hoti, abhejj'āssa honti parisā, bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

8421.meaning1: with an indivisible community; with a united assembly

examples.text: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? abhejjapariso hoti, abhejj'āssa honti parisā, bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

8422.commentary: (ANa) abhedanamukhānī'ti na kenaci bhinditvā katāni, kevalaṃ kammasamuṭṭhitān'eva vaṇamukhāni.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na gilitabaḷiso mārassa abhedi baḷisaṃ paribhedi baḷisaṃ na anayaṃ āpanno na byasanaṃ āpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso daliddo'va samāno aḍḍhavādaṃ vadeyya, adhano'va samāno dhanavāvādaṃ vadeyya, abhogo'va samāno bhogavāvādaṃ vadeyya.

8425.meaning1: not edible; not fit to be eaten

examples.text: gāth'ābhigītaṃ me abhojaneyyaṃ, sampassataṃ brāhmaṇa n'esa dhammo, gāth'ābhigītaṃ panudanti buddhā, dhamme satī brāhmaṇa vutti'r'esā.
te hi sotthiṃ gamissanti, kacche'va-amakase magā, jhānāni upasampajja, ekodi nipakā satā'ti.

8429.meaning1: not depreciating; not denigrating; not disparaging; not besmirching
8429.notes: see BHS mrakṣa for discussion on meaning

examples.text: makkhissa purisapuggalassa amakkho hoti parikkamanāya, paḷāsissa purisapuggalassa apaḷāso hoti parikkamanāya, issukissa purisapuggalassa anissukitā hoti parikkamanāya
upanāhissa purisapuggalassa anupanāho hoti parinibbānāya. makkhissa purisapuggalassa amakkho hoti parinibbānāya.

8430.commentary: (DNt) amakkhitova nikkhamati sammakkhitassa tādisassa udakasemh'ādikass'eva tattha abhāvato. bodhisattassa hi puññ'ānubhāvato paṭisandhiggahaṇato paṭṭhāya taṃ ṭhānaṃ pubbe'pi visuddhaṃ visesato paramasugandhagandhakuṭi viya candanagandhaṃ vāyantaṃ tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: ubhinnaṃ suddhattā. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, visado'va nikkhamati amakkhito, udena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado. ayam'ettha dhammatā.
ṭhitako'va mātukucchisambhavena kenaci asucinā amakkhito suddho visado kāsikavatthe nikkhittamaṇiratanaṃ viya jotayanto mātukucchito nikkhami.

8431.meaning1: who does not slander; who does not denigrate; (comm) who does not erase the good qualities of another
8431.commentary: (DNa) makkhī hoti paḷāsī'ti paraguṇamakkhanalakkhaṇena makkhena, yugaggāhalakkhaṇena paḷāsena ca samannāgato.

examples.text: pare makkhī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha amakkhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu amakkhī hoti apaḷāsī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

8432.meaning1: wrong way; incorrect road; not the path
8432.commentary: (DHPa) ayaṃ duggatiyā maggo, ayaṃ sugatiyā maggo, ayaṃ nibbānassa maggo, ayaṃ amaggo'ti evaṃ magge ca amagge ca chekatāya magg'āmaggassa kovidaṃ

examples.text: gambhīrapaññaṃ medhāviṃ, magga-amaggassa kovidaṃ, uttam'attham'anuppattaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

8433.meaning1: who does not know the road well; not knowing the way; not skilled in the path
8433.meaning2: who does not know the road well; not knowing the way

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, tissa, dve purisā, eko puriso amaggakusalo, eko puriso maggakusalo. tam'enaṃ so amaggakusalo puriso amuṃ maggakusalaṃ purisaṃ maggaṃ puccheyya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ehi, bho purisa, ayaṃ maggo.

8434.meaning1: not embarrassed; not shy; not reserved

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.

8435.commentary: (PYt) amacco'ti sabbarājakiccesu amā saha raññā bhavatī'ti amacco. (APt) sabbakiccesu raññā mantena amā saha bhavatī'ti amacco, amāsaddoyaṃ nipāto sahatthe ccapaccayo.

examples.text: tatth'eva vasanto paṇḍitaṃ vīmaṃsatū'ti amaccassa dūtaṃ paṭipesesi. taṃ sutvā amacco tatth'eva vasanto paṇḍitaṃ vīmaṃsi
rājā'pi amacce pakkosāpetvā, mayhaṃ bhāgineyyo'pi imassa rajjassa sāmiko'va, dhītaraṃ etass'eva datvā abhisekam'assa karomī'ti.
labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitta-amaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti
ye vā pan'assa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukakāmā yogakkhemakāmā mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā
atha kho, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko amacce pārisajje āmantesi, kahaṃ nu kho, bho, eta'r'ahi kumārā sammantī'ti?

8438.meaning1: surrounded by ministers; encircled by royal officials

examples.text: cakkavattī yathā rājā, amaccaparivārito, samantā anupariyeti, sāgar'antaṃ mahiṃ imaṃ.

8439.meaning1: what is beyond the realm of death; what is outside the sphere of death; what is beyond the power of death

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā akusalā imassa lokassa akusalā parassa lokassa, akusalā māradheyyassa akusalā amāradheyyassa, akusalā maccudheyyassa akusalā amaccudheyyassa, tesaṃ ye sotabbaṃ saddahātabbaṃ maññissanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.

8440.grammar: nt, abstr, from na macchara, neg
8440.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: maccharissa purisapuggalassa amacchariyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, saṭhassa purisapuggalassa asāṭheyyaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, māyāvissa purisapuggalassa amāyā hoti parikkamanāya

8441.meaning1: free from avarice; not selfish; not stingy; not covetous
8441.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: sace musā na bhaṇasi, sace pāṇaṃ na hiṃsasi, sace adinnaṃ n'ādiyasi, saddahāno amaccharī, kiṃ kāhasi gayaṃ gantvā, udapāno'pi te gayā'ti.
patilīno akuhako, apihālu amaccharī, appagabbho ajeguccho, pesuṇeyye ca no yuto.

8442.notes: Kaccāyana 630, 654 suggests an unlikely root √masu, the -su- of which changes to -cchara- or -cchera-.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu anissukī hoti amaccharī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu anissukī hoti amaccharī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

8444.meaning1: not an intoxicant; not a drug; not alcohol

examples.text: amajje majjasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amajje vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amajje amajjasaññī, anāpatti.

8445.meaning2: who does not take strong drinks, abstaining form intoxicants

examples.text: amajje majjasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amajje vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amajje amajjasaññī, anāpatti.

8447.grammar: prp of na maññati, neg, trans (+acc)
8447.meaning1: not thinking; not imagining; not conceiving

examples.text: evaṃ sukhumaṃ kho, bhikkhave, vepacittibandhanaṃ. tato sukhumataraṃ mārabandhanaṃ. maññamāno kho, bhikkhave, baddho mārassa, amaññamāno mutto pāpimato.
maññitaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, maññitaṃ gaṇḍo, maññitaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, amaññamānena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

8448.grammar: aor reflx 3rd pl of amaññi, irreg form of amaññū, trans (+acc)
8448.commentary: (MNa) n'āññaṃ bhiyyo amaññarun'ti koci eko'pi ahaṃ bālo'ti na ca maññi (PYt) iminā amaññarun'ti ettha āvibhattiyā run'ti ādeso dassito.

examples.text: puthusaddo samajano, na bālo koci maññatha, saṅghasmiṃ bhijjamānasmiṃ, n'āññaṃ bhiyyo amaññaruṃ.
te'p'ime tayo niruttipathe adhivacanapathe paññattipathe na garahitabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu? nindā-ghaṭṭana-byārosa-upārambha-bhayā'ti.
ye'pi te, bhikkhave, ahesuṃ okkalā vassabhaññā ahetuvādā akiriyavādā n'atthikavādā te'pi mahācattārīsakaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na garahitabbaṃ napaṭikkositabbaṃ amaññiṃsu.

8451.grammar: aor 1st sg of amaññi, irreg form of amaññiṃ, trans (+acc)
8451.meaning1: I thought; I imagined; I presumed; I supposed

examples.text: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yo'haṃ bhagavantaṃ āvusovādena samudācaritabbaṃ amaññissaṃ.
api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ

8452.meaning1: not a jewel; not a gemstone; not a crystal

8454.grammar: nt, pp of na marati, neg
8454.meaning1: deathless state; immortality; freedom from death; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: etaṃ amataṃ yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho.
so ca sabbadado hoti, yo dadāti upassayaṃ, amataṃ dado ca so hoti, yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti.
n'ābhāsamānaṃ jānanti, missaṃ bālehi paṇḍitaṃ, bhāsamānañ'ca jānanti, desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati

8456.meaning1: way leading to the deathless; path going to immortality

examples.text: yo kho, bhikkhu, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo, idaṃ vuccati amataṃ. ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo amatagāmimaggo, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi … sammāsamādhī'ti.

8457.meaning1: leading to the deathless; going to immortality

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgiko ca maggānaṃ, khemaṃ amatagāminan'ti.
amatañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi amatagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

8458.meaning1: deathless drum; i.e. knowledge of the way to Nibbāna

examples.text: dhammacakkaṃ pavattetuṃ, gacchāmi kāsinaṃ puraṃ, andhībhūtasmiṃ lokasmiṃ, āhañchaṃ amatadundubhin'ti.

8460.meaning1: door to the deathless state; entrance to Nibbāna

examples.text: sabbaṃ lokaṃ abhiññāya, sambuddhena pajānatā, vivaṭaṃ amatadvāraṃ, khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā.

seyyathā'pi, bhante ānanda, puriso ekaṃ'va nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto saki'd'eva ekādasa nidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya. evam'eva kho ahaṃ, bhante, ekaṃ amatadvāraṃ gavesanto saki'd'eva ekādasa amatadvārāni alatthaṃ bhāvanāya.

8461.meaning1: deathless state; immortality; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: te ca bhagavā sabbaṃ papañcaṃ, sabbaṃ yogaṃ, sabbaṃ ganthaṃ, sabbaṃ saṃyojanaṃ, samucchinditvā amatadhātuṃ samadhigacchanto vami uggiri anapekkho chaḍḍayi, na paccāgami.

8463.meaning1: immortality; deathless state; epithet of Nibbāna; (comm) path to the deathless
8463.commentary: (DHPa) amatapadan'ti amataṃ vuccati nibbānaṃ. tañ'hi ajātattā nu jīyati na mīyati, tasmā amatan'ti vuccati. pajjan'ti iminā'ti padaṃ, amataṃ pāpuṇantī'ti attho. amatassa padaṃ amatapadaṃ, amatassa adhigam'ūpāyo'ti vuttaṃ hoti (THa) amatapadaṃ nibbānaṃ (JAa) amatapadan'ti amatassa nibbānassa padaṃ adhigamakāraṇaṃ.

examples.text: mam'eva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ, sabbaṃ idaṃ calam'iti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.
appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.

8464.meaning1: destined for the deathless; bound for immortality

examples.text: paññ'indriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amat'ogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānan'ti

8465.meaning1: destined for the deathless; culminating in immortality
8465.commentary: (NIDD1a) amataparāyanan'ti vuttappakāraṃ amataṃ paraṃ ayanaṃ gati patiṭṭhā assā'ti amataparāyanaṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti amat'ogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti amat'ogadhaṃ amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.

8466.meaning1: ending in the deathless; terminating in the deathless
8466.commentary: (SNa) amatapariyosānan'ti amataniṭṭhaṃ (ANa) amatapariyosānā'ti nibbān'āvasānā. (NIDD1a) amatapariyosānan'ti taṃ amataṃ saṃsārassa niṭṭhābhūtattā pariyosānam'assā'ti amatapariyosānaṃ.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
paññ'indriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amat'ogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyaṇaṃ amatapariyosānan'ti

8467.meaning1: state ending in the deathless; epithet of Nibbāna
8467.commentary: (VISMa) amatapariyosānatan'ti nibbānaniṭṭhitaṃ āhāre paṭikkūlasaññābhāvanā-saṅkhātaṃ upacārajjhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā nibbān'ādhigaman'ti attho.

examples.text: imaṃ pana paṭipattiṃ nissāya diṭṭh'eva dhamme amatapariyosānataṃ anabhisambhuṇanto sugatiparāyano hotī'ti.

8470.commentary: (SNPa) sā hoti amatapphalā, sā esā kasī amatapphalā hoti. amataṃ vuccati nibbānaṃ, nibbān'ānisaṃsā hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: evamesā kasī kaṭṭhā, sā hoti amatapphalā, etaṃ kasiṃ kasitvāna, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.

8471.meaning2: path to deathlessness; way to immortality

8472.meaning1: the deathless state is attained; immortality has been achieved

examples.text: odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ, amatam'adhigataṃ, aham'anusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.

8475.meaning1: door to the deathless state; entrance to Nibbāna

examples.text: pāturahosi magadhesu pubbe, dhammo asuddho samalehi cintito, apāpur'etaṃ amatassa dvāraṃ, suṇantu dhammaṃ vimalen'ānubuddhaṃ.
ete tayo devamanussaseṭṭhā, pabhaṅ'karā dhammam'udīrayantā, apāpuranti amatassa dvāraṃ, yogā pamocenti hujjanaṃ te.

8476.meaning2: Chapter 5 of the Satipaṭṭhānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

8478.meaning1: immortality; deathless state; way to the deathless; path to immortality

examples.text: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, apassaṃ amataṃ padaṃ, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, passato amataṃ padaṃ.
saritvā pubbake yogī, tesaṃ vattam'anussaraṃ, kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo, phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ.
ajaraṃ amataṃ amat'ādhigamaṃ, phalamagganidassanaṃ dukkhanudaṃ, sahitattaṃ mah'ārasahassakaraṃ, bhūtam'iti sāraṃ vividhaṃ suṇātha.

8482.meaning1: flowing into the deathless; immersed in the deathless; (comm) ending in Nibbāna
8482.commentary: (SNa) amat'ogadhan'ti amatabbhantaraṃ. (ANa) amat'ogadhā'ti nibbān'ogadhā, nibbānapatiṭṭhā'ti attho (ANa) amat'ogadhā'ti ettha saupādisesā nibbānadhātu kathitā

examples.text: yass'ālayā na vijjanti, aññāya akathaṃkathī, amat'ogadham'anuppattaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

tatr'āsayaṃ kappetvā amuṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ nevāpikassa ananupakhajja amucchitā bhojanāni bhuñjissāma, ananupakhajja amucchitā bhojanāni bhuñjamānā na madaṃ āpajjissāma, amattā samānā na pamādaṃ āpajjissāma, appamattā samānā na yathākāmakaraṇīyā bhavissāma nevāpikassa amusmiṃ nivāpe'ti.

8484.grammar: nt, pp of na majjati, neg

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pan'udāyi, app'ekadā ākiṇṇo viharāmi bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahā-amattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi.

8486.meaning1: immoderation (in); not knowing the correct amount (of)
8486.construction:
na > a + matta + ñu + tā
amattaññu + tā
8486.commentary: (DNa) bhojane amattaññutā'ti tattha katamā bhojane amattaññutā? idh'ekacco appaṭisaṅkhā ayoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti davāya madāya maṇḍanāya vibhūsanāya. yā tattha asantuṭṭhitā amattaññutā appaṭisaṅkhā bhojane'ti evaṃ āgato bhojane amattaññubhāvo. anantaraduko vuttappaṭipakkhanayena veditabbo.

examples.text: indriyesu aguttadvāratā ca bhojane amattaññutā ca.

8487.commentary: (MNa) bhojane amattaññuno'ti bhojane yā mattā jānitabbā pariyesana-paṭiggahaṇa-paribhogesu yuttatā, tassā ajānanakā.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… indriyesu aguttadvārā bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttā sāmaññe anapekkhavanto… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi ca-amattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.

8489.meaning1: not honouring one's mother; not respecting one's mother
8489.commentary: (ANa) amatteyyo'ti mātu hito matteyyo, mātari sammā paṭipanno'ti attho. na matteyyoti amatteyyo, mātari micchā paṭipanno'ti attho.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā nānābāhāsu gahetvā yamassa rañño dassenti, ayaṃ, deva, puriso amatteyyo apetteyyo asāmañño abrahmañño, na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī. imassa devo daṇḍaṃ paṇetū'ti.

8490.grammar: fem, abstr, from na matteyya, neg
8490.construction:
na > a + mātā + eyya + tā
amatteyya + tā
8490.commentary: (DNa) amatteyyatā'ti-ādīsu mātu hito matteyyo, tassa bhāvo matteyyatā, mātari sammā paṭipattiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ. tassā abhāvo c'eva tappaṭipakkhatā ca amatteyyatā. apetteyyat'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: aḍḍhateyyavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu ime dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. amatteyyatā apetteyyatā asāmaññatā abrahmaññatā na kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitā.

8494.grammar: abs of na manasi karoti, comp vb, neg, trans (+acc)
8494.meaning1: having not paid attention; having not applied the mind
8494.construction:
na > a + manasi + katvā
na + manasikatvā

8495.grammar: ptp of na manasikaroti, comp, neg
8495.meaning1: should not be attended to; should not be kept in mind
8495.meaningLit: not to be made in mind

examples.text: tassa amanasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ amanasikārā manasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ manasikārā anuppannā c'eva āsavā na uppajjanti, uppannā ca āsavā pahīyanti

8496.grammar: abs of na manasikaroti, comp vb, neg, trans (+acc)
8496.meaning1: having not paid attention (to); having not kept in mind
8496.construction:
na > a + manasi + karitvā
na + manasikaritvā

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso amuṃ telapattaṃ amanasikaritvā bahiddhā pamādaṃ āhareyyā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante

8497.grammar: prp of na manasikaroti, comp vb, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: saṃvāsena kho, mahārāja, sīlaṃ veditabbaṃ. tañ'ca kho dīghena addhunā, na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā, no amanasikarotā, paññavatā, no duppaññena.

8498.commentary: (MNa) amanasikāro'ti rūpāni passato vicikicchā uppajjati, idāni kiñci na manasikarissāmī'ti amanasikāro udapādi.

examples.text: kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā'ti? dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā, sabbanimittānañ'ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro.
idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

8499.meaning1: lack of attention; not paying heed (to)

examples.text: tassa amanasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ manasikārā manasikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ amanasikārā anuppannā c'eva āsavā uppajjanti uppannā ca āsavā pavaḍḍhanti.
